editorial.claim: The move signals an attempt to present Iraq as a sovereign state capable of managing its own security while still courting U.S. goodwill.
Observers should look for concrete, monitorable benchmarks that go beyond rhetoric: verified weapons handover, transparent militia payrolls, and a clear post‑surrender plan for fighters.
